title: TCMI-F-6D benchmark construction and quantitative assessment of interdisciplinary foundational competencies in traditional Chinese medicine informatics using large language models

live_model.evidence: Sec 3.1.4: "Twenty representative LLMs were selected...including the ChatGPT series (GPT-4-Turbo, GPT-3.5-Turbo)..."; Table 4 row "ChatGPT-4-turbo 87.55 86.71 74.00 71.43 94.00 85.95 83.27".

prompt.location: Sec 3 (n-shot MCQ prompting on MMLU-derived questions; standard MMLU few-shot question format, not reprinted verbatim in this paper)
prompt.note: TCMI-F-6D is built directly from public MMLU subsets, so the underlying question format is the well-known MMLU template rather than a paper-specific one.

claim.metric: average accuracy across six TCM-relevant MMLU subjects (Clin.Knowl, Coll.Med, Coll.CS, Mach.Learn, Med.Genet, Nutrition)
claim.location: Table 4, row ChatGPT-4-turbo, Average column; Table 6 confirms Mean accuracy = 83.27

data.source: TCMI-F-6D benchmark, built from public MMLU subsets via huggingface.co/datasets/cais/mmlu (Data availability statement)

notes: The paper also reports 5-shot / n-shot learning-curve results (Tables 7-8, Experiments 2-3) for ChatGPT-4-turbo, which would need the exact few-shot example selection to reproduce precisely. DeepSeek-V3.1 outperforms ChatGPT-4-turbo overall (85.60 vs 83.27) but is outside the tracked OpenAI id list.
